# Teachy

> Teachy is an AI-powered platform for teachers and students that automates lesson planning, generates educational content, and provides personalized learning tools across K-12 education.

Teachy offers comprehensive AI solutions for educators and students, including intelligent lesson planning, exam preparation, automated grading, and classroom resource generation. The platform is available in 10+ languages and serves teachers globally with curriculum-aligned materials and assessment tools.

## Key Topics

- AI Lesson Planning
- Personalized Learning
- Automated Grading
- Educational Content Generation
- Classroom Resources
- Teacher Productivity
- Curriculum-Based Materials
- AI Teaching Assistant
- Exam Preparation
- Bloom's Taxonomy
- ChatGPT Integration
- Mock Exams
- Flashcards
- School Management
- Student Study Tools

## Core Platforms

- [Teachy - Artificial Intelligence for Teachers](https://teachy.ai): Main Teachy platform for teachers: AI-powered lesson plans, questions, and educational activities for K-12
- [Teacher Dashboard](https://teachy.ai/school): School management platform: automate administrative processes and empower teachers with AI tools
- [Student Learning Platform](https://teachy.ai/student): Student-focused platform: exam prep, study tools, mock exams, flashcards, and personalized learning exercises
